SELECT C.COUPON_ID, C.COUPON_CODE, C.COUPON_NAME, C.COUPON_TYPE, C.DISCOUNT_VALUE, C.MAX_DISCOUNT_AMT, C.MIN_ORDER_AMT, C.TOTAL_QTY, C.ISSUED_QTY, C.TOTAL_BUDGET, C.ISSUED_BUDGET, C.USE_START_DATE, C.USE_END_DATE, C.STATUS_CD, B.BIZ_NAME, TO_CHAR(C.BIZ_MEMBER_NO) AS BIZ_NO, B.BIZ_TYPE, CASE B.BIZ_TYPE WHEN 'HOSPITAL' THEN ( SELECT MAX(H.HOSPITAL_ID) FROM TB_HOSPITAL H WHERE H.BIZ_NO = B.BIZ_NO ) WHEN 'STAY' THEN ( SELECT MAX(S.STAY_ID) FROM TB_STAY S WHERE S.BIZ_NO = B.BIZ_NO ) ELSE NULL END AS TARGET_ID,
CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MEMBER_COUPON MC WHERE MC.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND MC.COUPON_ID = C.COUPON_ID ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ALREADY_CLAIMED
0 AS ALREADY_CLAIMED
FROM TB_COUPON C LEFT JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = C.BIZ_MEMBER_NO WHERE C.APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND C.STATUS_CD != 'INACTIVE' AND C.USE_END_DATE >= #{today} ORDER BY CASE C.STATUS_CD WHEN 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 WHEN 'EXHAUSTED' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, C.REG_DATE DESC

SELECT MC.MEMBER_COUPON_ID, MC.STATUS_CD AS MEMBER_COUPON_STATUS, NULL AS USED_DATE, MC.REG_DATE, MC.EXPIRE_DATE, C.COUPON_ID, C.COUPON_CODE, C.COUPON_NAME, C.COUPON_TYPE, C.DISCOUNT_VALUE, C.MAX_DISCOUNT_AMT, C.MIN_ORDER_AMT, C.USE_START_DATE, C.USE_END_DATE, B.BIZ_NAME FROM TB_MEMBER_COUPON MC JOIN TB_COUPON C ON C.COUPON_ID = MC.COUPON_ID LEFT JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = C.BIZ_MEMBER_NO WHERE MC.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY CASE MC.STATUS_CD WHEN 'UNUSED' THEN 1 WHEN 'USED' THEN 2 WHEN 'EXPIRED' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, MC.REG_DATE DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MEMBER_COUPON MC JOIN TB_COUPON C ON C.COUPON_ID = MC.COUPON_ID WHERE MC.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND MC.STATUS_CD = 'UNUSED' AND C.USE_END_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_MEMBER_COUPON ( MEMBER_COUPON_ID, MEMBER_NO, COUPON_ID, STATUS_CD, REG_DATE, USE_END_DATE ) SELECT SEQ_MEMBER_COUPON.NEXTVAL, #{memberNo}, #{couponId}, 'UNUSED', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{useEndDate} FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MEMBER_COUPON WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND COUPON_ID = #{couponId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_COUPON SET ISSUED_QTY = NVL(ISSUED_QTY, 0) + 1, ISSUED_BUDGET = NVL(ISSUED_BUDGET, 0) + #{discountValue}, STATUS_CD = CASE WHEN NVL(ISSUED_QTY, 0) + 1 >= TOTAL_QTY THEN 'EXHAUSTED' WHEN TOTAL_BUDGET IS NOT NULL AND (TOTAL_BUDGET - (NVL(ISSUED_BUDGET, 0) + #{discountValue})) < #{discountValue} THEN 'EXHAUSTED' ELSE STATUS_CD END, MOD_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') WHERE COUPON_ID = #{couponId} AND STATUS_CD = 'ACTIVE' AND NVL(ISSUED_QTY, 0) < TOTAL_QTY AND (TOTAL_BUDGET IS NULL OR NVL(ISSUED_BUDGET, 0) + #{discountValue} <= TOTAL_BUDGET)
mapper.select: SELECT COUPON_ID, COUPON_TYPE, DISCOUNT_VALUE, MAX_DISCOUNT_AMT, TOTAL_BUDGET, ISSUED_BUDGET, TOTAL_QTY, ISSUED_QTY, STATUS_CD, USE_START_DATE, USE_END_DATE FROM TB_COUPON WHERE COUPON_ID = #{couponId} AND APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED'

SELECT C.COUPON_ID, C.COUPON_CODE, C.COUPON_NAME, C.COUPON_TYPE, C.DISCOUNT_VALUE, C.MIN_ORDER_AMT, C.USE_START_DATE, C.USE_END_DATE, C.STATUS_CD, TO_CHAR(C.BIZ_MEMBER_NO) AS BIZ_NO, B.BIZ_NAME, B.BIZ_TYPE, CASE B.BIZ_TYPE WHEN 'HOSPITAL' THEN ( SELECT MAX(H.HOSPITAL_ID) FROM TB_HOSPITAL H WHERE H.BIZ_NO = B.BIZ_NO ) WHEN 'STAY' THEN ( SELECT MAX(S.STAY_ID) FROM TB_STAY S WHERE S.BIZ_NO = B.BIZ_NO ) ELSE NULL END AS TARGET_ID FROM TB_COUPON C JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = C.BIZ_MEMBER_NO WHERE C.COUPON_ID = #{couponId} AND C.APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED'

SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_CD, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.BRAND_NAME, P.CATEGORY_ID, TO_NUMBER(P.PRICE) AS PRICE, TO_NUMBER(P.SALE_PRICE) AS SALE_PRICE, F.FILE_URL AS THUMBNAIL_URL, NVL(RV.AVG_RATING, 0) AS AVG_RATING, NVL(RV.REVIEW_COUNT, 0) AS REVIEW_COUNT
FROM TB_PRODUCT P
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT REF_ID, FILE_URL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY REF_ID ORDER BY FILE_ID ) AS RN FROM TB_FILE WHERE REF_TYPE = 'PRODUCT' ) F ON F.REF_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID AND F.RN = 1
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TARGET_ID, ROUND(AVG(RATING), 1) AS AVG_RATING, COUNT(REVIEW_ID) AS REVIEW_COUNT FROM TB_REVIEW WHERE REVIEW_TYPE = 'PRODUCT' GROUP BY TARGET_ID ) RV ON RV.TARGET_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID, SUM(QTY) AS SALES_QTY FROM TB_ORDER_ITEM GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID ) SALES ON SALES.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID
WHERE TO_CHAR(P.BIZ_NO) = TRIM(#{bizNo}) AND P.STATUS_CD = 'NORMAL'
AND ( UPPER(P.PRODUCT_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(P.BRAND_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(P.SALE_PRICE) ASC
ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(P.SALE_PRICE) DESC
ORDER BY NVL(SALES.SALES_QTY, 0) DESC, P.PRODUCT_ID DESC

SELECT MC.MEMBER_COUPON_ID, C.COUPON_ID, C.COUPON_NAME, C.COUPON_TYPE, C.DISCOUNT_VALUE, C.MAX_DISCOUNT_AMT, C.MIN_ORDER_AMT, TO_CHAR(C.BIZ_NO) AS BIZ_NO FROM TB_MEMBER_COUPON MC JOIN TB_COUPON C ON C.COUPON_ID = MC.COUPON_ID WHERE MC.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND MC.STATUS_CD = 'UNUSED' AND C.BIZ_NO = #{bizNo} AND C.USE_END_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') ORDER BY MC.MEMBER_COUPON_ID

SELECT MC.MEMBER_COUPON_ID, C.COUPON_ID, C.COUPON_NAME, C.COUPON_TYPE, C.DISCOUNT_VALUE, C.MAX_DISCOUNT_AMT, C.MIN_ORDER_AMT, TO_CHAR(C.BIZ_NO) AS BIZ_NO FROM TB_MEMBER_COUPON MC JOIN TB_COUPON C ON C.COUPON_ID = MC.COUPON_ID WHERE MC.MEMBER_COUPON_ID = #{memberCouponId} AND MC.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND MC.STATUS_CD = 'UNUSED'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_MEMBER_COUPON SET STATUS_CD = 'USED' WHERE MEMBER_COUPON_ID = #{memberCouponId} AND STATUS_CD = 'UNUSED'
UPDATE TB_MEMBER_COUPON SET STATUS_CD = 'UNUSED' WHERE MEMBER_COUPON_ID = #{memberCouponId} AND STATUS_CD = 'USED'
UPDATE TB_MEMBER_COUPON SET STATUS_CD = 'EXPIRED' WHERE STATUS_CD = 'UNUSED' AND USE_END_DATE IS NOT NULL AND TO_DATE(USE_END_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') < SYSDATE
